issues.jp_before: {来月[らいげつ]|ym-n5-move}から新[あたら]しい仕事[しごと]が始[はじ]まります。
issues.problem: Distractor こじげつ is not a reading any learner would assemble (来 is never こじ).
issues.action: Replaced こじげつ with きげつ (from 来ます).

issues.jp_before: 駅[えき]の{入口[いりぐち]|ym-n5-move}で友達[ともだち]を待[ま]っています。
issues.problem: Distractor いりくち is a dictionary-listed variant reading of 入口, so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced いりくち with にゅうぐち; clarified the why.

issues.jp_before: {今日[きょう]|ym-jukuji}は朝[あさ]からとても寒[さむ]いですね。
issues.problem: English was ungrammatical ('It is really cold since the morning today').
issues.action: English changed to 'It has been really cold since this morning, hasn't it?'

issues.jp_before: 誕生日[たんじょうび]に新[あたら]しい{時計[とけい]|ym-jukuji}を買[か]ってもらいました。
issues.problem: Unnatural English ('I got a new watch bought for me for my birthday').
issues.action: English changed to 'Someone bought me a new watch for my birthday.'

issues.jp_before: 次[つぎ]の駅[えき]でバスを{降[お]|ym-n3-a}ります。
issues.problem: 駅 is a train station; getting off a bus at the next 駅 is unnatural and does not match 'next stop'.
issues.action: Rewrote with 電車: 次の駅で電車を降ります / 'I will get off the train at the next station.'
